newsitem.title: USA: Western Gas raises capital spending plan.
newsitem.headline: Western Gas raises capital spending plan.

text.p: Western Gas Resources Inc said its 1997 capital expendure program was boosted to $134 million compared with its 1996 plan of $68 million.

Western plans to invest about $57 million, or 43 percent of the total program, for the development of gathering and treating operations in the Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef in East Texas. Another $45 million or 34 percent of the total program will be spent for three other internally generated projects aimed at increasing utilization of existing assets, aggressive growth in throughput volumes and improving product recoveries and values in several key growth areas.
